title: Kelas Memanjat
subject: a keeper at an orangutan rehabilitation centre in East Kalimantan who spends every morning of forest school coaxing one orphaned young orangutan off her back and onto a liana, counting the metres it climbs before it slides down to her again
caption: Dayak sape' folk-pop from East Kalimantan. Dayak sape' lute playing interlocking repeated motifs over a drone, soft long hand drum in a walking pattern, upright acoustic bass, breathy bamboo flute answering the voice, light hanging gong accents at phrase ends. Spacious natural reverb like an open wooden longhouse, unhurried. Warm female low-middle register with a plain, unornamented delivery and soft hummed backing. 84 BPM, A minor. Patient, tender and a little worried. No EDM, no trap, no pop drum kit, no autotune, no cinematic strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - sape' motif alone, flute enters]

[Verse 1]
Jam tujuh, kelas hutan dibuka
Kamu masih nempel di punggungku
Aku tunjuk akar yang menggantung
Kamu tunjuk rambutku

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu tangan, satu kaki
Pelan, pelan, aku di sini

[Chorus]
Naik sedikit, Sari, naik sedikit
Dua meter juga sudah jauh
Aku hitung dari bawah
Kalau turun, aku tangkap dulu

[Verse 2]
Minggu ini tiga meter, lalu empat
Kamu berhenti, lihat ke bawah
Aku pura-pura sibuk sama pisang
Supaya kamu lupa aku menunggu

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu tangan, satu kaki
Pelan, pelan, aku di sini

[Chorus]
Naik sedikit, Sari, naik sedikit
Empat meter, jauh dari punggungku
Aku hitung dari bawah
Kalau turun, aku tetap tunggu

[Bridge - sape' and gong only]
Suatu pagi kamu nggak turun
Dan aku harus belajar pulang sendiri

[Outro - sape' drone, hummed melody, gong]
